tei:div.tei:p:
God, Lord above all works, blessed and called blessed by the mouth of every soul, His grandeur and His goodness fill the world, knowledge and understanding surround Him. He who is exalted above the holy Hayoth, splendid in glory above the Merkabah, merit and equity are On Sabbath.
before His throne, grace and compassion before His glory. Good are the lights which our God has created, He has formed them with knowledge, reason and understanding. Power and strength has He placed in them that they may reign in the midst of the world. They are full of lustre and brightly shine, comely is their lustre over the whole world. They rejoice when they go forth and are jubilant when they come in and fulfil in awe the will of their Owner. Glory and honour do they give to His Name, joy and delight at the mention of His Kingdom. He called to the sun, then light shone forth, He saw and decreed the shape of the moon. Praise does the whole host of heaven bestow on Him, fame and grandeur the Seraphim, Ophanim and holy Hayoth.
